title: The Body: A Guide for Occupants
author: Bill Bryson
summary: Bill Bryson tours the human body system by system, from skin and brain to immune defenses and the heart, with stories from the history of medicine and plenty of odd facts about how we work.
readIf: you enjoy science explained with humor and curiosity rather than jargon.
skipIf: you want a deep clinical text or practical health advice for your own body.
